title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1119 | 自行车空翻、地狱鸡恐龙、章鱼逃脱术
description:
🎧 本期音频为全英文，适合有一定英语基础的小朋友。

👧 今天 Mia 和 Lina 聊了三个新鲜事：

🚲 十四岁男孩骑自行车空翻三米多高，还一口气连翻十个！
🦖 新恐龙“地狱鸡”爱吃水果，化石正在加拿大多伦多展出。
🐙 章鱼没有骨头，能从比眼睛还小的洞里挤过去逃走！

📖 Word of the day: flip（翻跟头；翻转）

🎮 谜语时间：我有八条胳膊却从不抱抱，没有骨头，能从小洞里挤过去——我是谁？答案：章鱼！

---
🇬🇧 In today's episode:

🚲 A fourteen-year-old boy flipped his bicycle three point one three meters high — and did ten flips in a row!
🦖 A brand new dinosaur nicknamed the Hell Chicken loved to eat fruit, and its fossils are now on show in Toronto.
🐙 An octopus with no bones can squeeze through a hole smaller than the space between its own eyes!

📖 Word of the day: flip

🎮 Riddle time: I have eight arms but I never hug, and I have no bones at all, so I can squeeze through a tiny hole. Who am I? An octopus!

📝 生词本 Words to learn

1. flip（翻跟头；翻转）
A flip is when you turn all the way over in the air.
例：The boy did a big flip on his bike.（这个男孩在自行车上翻了个大跟头。）

2. fossil（化石）
A fossil is the old bones or marks of a plant or animal that lived a very long time ago.
例：Scientists found the dinosaur fossil in America.（科学家在美国发现了这只恐龙的化石。）

3. squeeze（挤过去；挤进）
To squeeze is to push something soft through a small space.
例：The octopus can squeeze through a tiny hole.（章鱼能从一个小洞里挤过去。）

4. escape（逃脱；逃走）
To escape is to get away from a place.
例：The octopus escaped from the box.（章鱼从盒子里逃了出来。）
